purpose: Batch 2 (run FIRST): across-sampler-seed variance per regime cell for the three built families — the power input every downstream experiment depends on. A measurement, not a claim generator; no cross-model or moral ranking is claimed.
notes: seeds [1,2] cover BOTH paraphrase variants of every 2-variant scenario (pick_variant = variants[seed % 2]; 2->v0, 1->v1); the prereg pins 'scenario_seed = each variant's seed'. 3 models x 4 scenarios x 2 variants x 5 sampler seeds = 120 runs. Interaction modes never pool; retries collapse; digests pin the frozen regime (a repull aborts the run before any compute).
